newsitem.title: USA: Watson gets FDA OK on form of Indapamide.
newsitem.headline: Watson gets FDA OK on form of Indapamide.

text.p: Watson Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday its unit Watson Laboratories has received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market off-patent tablet forms of Indapamide, an anti-hypertensive drug.
Indapamide will compete with Lozol, which is currently marketed by Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc. Sales of Lozol are estimated to be some $60 million for 1996, Watson said in a statement.
Shares of Watson were 1-5/8 higher at 36-5/8 in morning trading on Nasdaq.
